steps.description: 默认展开时只显示可见的侧边栏图标，无 Logo

steps.name: expanded-idle
steps.expression: (() => {const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="切换侧边栏"]');const s=b?.querySelector('svg'); const r=b?.getBoundingClientRect(); return {hasLogo:!!b?.querySelector('img'),icon:s?.getAttribute('class'),opacity:s?getComputedStyle(s).opacity:null,left:r?.left,top:r?.top};})()

steps.description: 展开状态 hover 不改变图标或透明度
